name: io.github.tonyyang0504/bluesky-mcp
description: Bluesky (social): me, publish_text, read_comments, read_mentions, analytics_post. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER
environmentVariables.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. alice.bsky.social) or the account's e-mail; sent as `identifier` to com.atproto.server.createSession.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: An app password from Settings → Privacy and security → App Passwords, never the account password; the runtime exchanges it for a short-lived accessJwt (createSession is capped at 300/day per IP, so the token is cached and re-issued only on expiry or 401).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BLUESKY_DID
environmentVariables.description: The account's DID (did:plc:..., shown in Settings → Account or returned by com.atproto.server.getSession); used as `repo` when writing records. The createRecord lexicon also accepts the handle here.
